title: peutalis polystachya
intro: Peutalis polystachya, commonly known as Prang, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Peutalis polystachya include antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating various conditions.
